question: 750(1)/(3) + 750(1)/(15) + 750(1)/(35) + dots + 750(1)/(99) = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify total terms: The denominators are 1×3, 3×5, 5×7, 7×9, and 9×11, so there are **5 terms**.

Sum of integer parts = 750 × 5 = **3750**.

Sum of fractional parts = (1 ÷ Difference) × [1/First factor − 1/Last factor].

Fraction sum = (1/2) × [1/1 − 1/11] = (1/2) × (10/11) = **5/11**.

Combined Result = 3750 + 5/11 = 3750 5/11.

**∴ The correct answer is 3750(5)/(11).**
